metadata.description: Imperial German Navy WWI Torpedo Roster for Unterseeboot

torpedoes.name: 45cm C/06 Bronze Torpedo
torpedoes.description: Early-war 45cm torpedo used by coastal UB-boats. Leaves a prominent bubble trail and suffers from high dud rates at oblique impact angles.

torpedoes.name: 50cm G/6 Wet-Heater Torpedo
torpedoes.description: Standard early-to-mid-war fleet torpedo. Carries a heavy 160kg warhead capable of breaking the back of most merchant steamers in a single hit.

torpedoes.name: 50cm G/7 Long-Range Torpedo
torpedoes.description: Improved late-war 7-meter torpedo with superior range, speed, and reliability. Essential for engaging fast troop transports and escorted convoys.
